Product details

Tell us what you have in mind

Every piece is handmade, so details vary. When you enquire, it helps to mention:

  • The occasion and date
  • Colours or flowers you like
  • Approximate size and quantity
  • Whether you’d like it gift-wrapped
  • Where it should be delivered

Gift wrapping

Gift-wrapped products are part of the range. Wrapping styles and any extra charges are confirmed when you enquire, so you know exactly what to expect.

Custom orders

Want a bouquet in particular colours or for an event? Send a custom order enquiry and we’ll discuss what’s possible.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How do I order?

Use the order enquiry form on this page, or follow RJ Creativity on Instagram. Tell us the product, quantity, occasion and delivery location and we’ll confirm the details with you.

Can you make a custom bouquet?

Yes. Custom bouquet enquiries are welcome. Share the occasion, colours you like and any ideas, and we’ll discuss what’s possible.

What are the prices?

Prices aren’t listed here. Use the enquiry form and the price for your requirement will be confirmed with you.

Are the products shown on this page real photos?

No. The pictures in the sample gallery are illustrations used as placeholders and are labelled as sample content. They aren’t photographs of actual products.

What about shipping, returns and cancellations?

These policies are still to be confirmed and are shown as pending below. Please ask when you place an enquiry.

Is there an online store?

RJ Creativity has an existing website, linked on this page. You can also enquire here or on Instagram.
